participant_id.Description: BIDS subject label; equal to the DANDI subject label of DANDI 000623 (e.g. sub-CS62).

age.Description: Age at the recording, from NWB general/subject/age (ISO 8601 duration, years). Values above 89 would be reported as 90.

epilepsy_diagnosis.Description: Epilepsy diagnosis (seizure-onset localisation) as stated in NWB general/subject/description ('epilepsy diagnosis: ...'), verbatim.

dandi_subject_id.Description: NWB general/subject/subject_id in the source file.

n_emu_runs.Description: Column "# of EMU runs" (movie-watching runs recorded in the epilepsy monitoring unit), Keles et al. 2024 Sci Data 11:214 doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03029-1 Table 1 "Patients" (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-024-03029-1/tables/1). Equals the number of sessions of the subject in this dataset (checked).

n_fmri_runs.Description: Column "# of fMRI runs" (runs of the same movie task acquired with fMRI before implantation; the fMRI data are not part of this iEEG dataset), Keles et al. 2024 Sci Data 11:214 doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03029-1 Table 1 "Patients" (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-024-03029-1/tables/1); NA in the source -> n/a.
